Theories in any scientific field, including aging research, serve to organize existing knowledge, explain observed phenomena, and generate hypotheses for future studies.  
Option (A) is incorrect because theories are foundational to research.  
Option (C) is too absolute — many theories have been tested.  
Option (D) is not necessarily true across all aging theories.  
Option (B) best captures the general purpose of theories: to explain findings and guide future research.  

Final answer: (B)
